hypothesis: Adding Creative Energy Allocation Architecture (Phase 4.5) — PEAK/CRUISE/COAST energy triage within single creation sessions — will make the Format Blueprint actionable at the session level, not just the format level
benchmark_task: Design a content creation system for Authority Flywheel that maximizes quality while minimizing creative drain
change_description: Phase 4.5: Creative Energy Allocation Map. 3-step process: (1) Moment Mapping — classify every phase of creation session as PEAK/CRUISE/COAST, (2) Energy Budget — 60-70% to PEAK, 20-25% CRUISE, 5-15% COAST, (3) Pre-Session Energy Priming — one question before each session. Micro-complement to GP-3 Effort Topology. Anti-pattern: spending >20% on COAST = subsidizing invisible work at expense of visible quality.
notes: Baseline diagnosed WHAT format to use but not WHERE to invest energy within each session. Variant fills the 'I know my format but still spend 2 hours per piece' gap. Strictly additive — inserted between Phase 4 (Format Blueprint) and Phase 5 (Shield Removal). First tom-noske-content-creation evolution.
